---
name: New Skill or Source Proposal
about: Suggest a new upstream skill repository or capability bundle for SFP
title: '[SOURCE] '
labels: ['skill-source']
assignees: ''
---

**Repository URL**
URL of the public Git repository containing the agent skills:
e.g. `https://github.com/owner/repo`

**License of Upstream Repository**
Specify the open-source license (e.g. MIT, Apache-2.0). Note: Only public repositories with clear open source licensing can be included.

**Proposed Category**
Which category does this skill best fit into?
- [ ] agent-dev
- [ ] agents
- [ ] code-quality
- [ ] dev-tools
- [ ] frameworks
- [ ] productivity
- [ ] other: [specify]

**Skill Summary & Value**
Briefly describe what the skill(s) do and how agentic IDEs benefit from having them in SFP.

**Verification Checklist**
- [ ] The repository is public.
- [ ] Names do not start with `claude-` or `anthropic-`.
- [ ] Instructions and commands have been tested.
